source.method: Word-by-word review by Claude (November 2026); no automatic links

1:2.note: "Beginning of the word of the LORD which was with Hosea"; plus relative "which was".

1:6.note: Plus "the LORD"; "but" for כי in last clause.

1:7.note: Negations "neither ... nor" repeated (plus) before each instrument.

1:9.note: Plus "to me, the LORD" and repeated "you".

2:1.note: Plus "and if"; "there they shall be called sons of the living God" (plus "there", minus second "to them").

2:7.note: Minus second כי; "my drink" paraphrased "all that I need"; wool rendered "garments".

2:8.note: "Her way" for MT "your way"; את unrendered.

2:9.note: Plus objects and "than it is now"; "return" and "go" transposed.

2:11.note: Plus "which I gave her"; "take" for הצלתי.

2:15.note: "Took" (her earrings) for ותעד; incense phrase periphrastic.

2:16.note: "Speak to her heart" as "fill her heart"(?), participles with pronoun.

2:17.note: "Door of hope" read as "to open her understanding"; ענתה as "be humbled".

3:1.note: Reads רַע as "evil" (adulteress who loves evil); order rearranged.

3:4.note: Pillar rendered "altar"; ephod "wearer of ephod"; teraphim paraphrased "incense-placer".

3:5.note: Reads פחדו as "they will know"(?) the LORD.

4:4.note: "Because no one judges or reproves"; second איש minus; כמריבי כהן as "like a contending priest".

4:5.note: "I have silenced your mother" for ודמיתי.

4:6.note: Minus "to me"; "I will forget your children" as "I will forget your sons".

4:7.note: Minus "against me"; אמיר read as "they exchanged".

4:9.note: "The priest shall be like the people" (order inverted).

4:10.note: לשמר not rendered; plus "and they loved" (joins v. 11).

4:14.note: "Visit" as "punish"; plus "and they"; קדשות as "women who go out to the street".

4:16.note: Plus "from the yoke, so"; "in a wide place".

4:18.note: Free: "all of them whored and loved shame"; סר סבאם and הבו not rendered; final word "fear" unclear.

5:2.note: Free: "a snare which hunters hid"; plus "snare", "but".

5:4.note: "Their deeds do not permit them to return".

5:7.note: Second half of verse (עתה יאכלם חדש את חלקיהם) missing in Syriac.

5:10.note: "Like those who remove a boundary"; clause order rearranged.

5:12.note: Plus "I will be"; רקב rendered "lion"(?) — likely variant.

5:14.note: Doubled "I" rendered once; כפיר as "lion's whelp".

5:15.note: "I will turn and go"; "in their distress they will seek me early".

6:1.note: Plus "and they will say"; "he struck ... he broke" paraphrase of טרף/יך.

6:5.note: "My judgment (goes forth) like light" (reads משפטי כאור).

6:8.note: "A city that does iniquity, stained with blood".

6:9.note: "Your strength" for וכחכי; "they killed at Shechem".

6:11.note: "Has made a harvest for you, when I return".

7:8.note: "A cake which before it was baked was eaten" (free).

7:9.note: Plus "thus"; first וְהוּא and גם not rendered.

7:11.note: "Broken dove" for יונה פותה; קראו as "they came".

7:14.note: Plus "with all (their heart)"; יתגוררו as "they quarrel(?)".

7:16.note: "They turned to nothing" (לא על); זו read as demonstrative.

8:1.note: "Your mouth like a horn and like an eagle"; אל not rendered.

8:2.note: Plus "and they said"; final "Israel" not rendered.

8:4.note: Minus הם; plus "but"; "they did not inform me".

8:7.note: Free conditional "and if there were (any) to them, strangers would eat it".

8:9.note: "Like a lonely wild ass"; minus "to him".

8:10.note: "Even if they are paid among the nations"; עתה not rendered.

9:1.note: "Do not exult"; "gifts from every threshing floor" (minus דגן).

9:6.note: "Their silver" desirable things; קמוש rendered "strangers(?) shall inherit".

9:13.note: Plus "so"; "bring out his sons to slaughter".

9:16.note: "That it may not give fruit"; plus "sons".

10:1.note: "Abandoned vine"; לו minus; "they built altars(?)" for היטיבו מצבות.

10:3.note: "From the LORD" as object of fear; second כי not rendered.

10:4.note: "Judgment sprouted like a forest"; field phrase reworded.

10:10.note: "When they are chastised for their two follies"; ketiv/qere both mapped.

10:11.note: טוב and לו not rendered; "Ephraim" as object of "ride".

10:12.note: "Kindle for yourselves a lamp" (reads ניר as lamp); plus "because".

10:15.note: "So they did to you"; נדמה נדמה as "it broke and was ashamed".

11:4.note: "Like one who lifts the yoke from their jaws"; "they ate".

11:7.note: "To God they call" (reads אל על as God); plus "they think".

11:8.note: "Or how" pluses; עלי and יחד not rendered.

11:9.note: Plus "I am"; "I will not enter the city".

12:1.note: "Deceit" moved to Judah; עד רד read "until he goes down"; עם read as "people".

12:4.note: "In the womb" as "in the womb" with plus "for".

12:5.note: Free; בכה not rendered; "spoke with him" for עמנו.

12:8.note: "Balances of deceit in the hand of Canaan" reordered.

12:9.note: און read as "pain"; "all my labour suffices not for the sin I sinned".

12:10.note: Plus "I am ... who brought you up".

12:12.note: אם and היו not rendered; "on field of the land fallow".

12:13.note: "For a wife ... for the sake of a wife".

13:1.note: Plus "and was great"; הוא not rendered.

13:4.note: Plus "I am ... who brought you up"; final plus "I".

13:5.note: "I shepherded you" (ידעתיך read as רעיתיך); plus "uninhabited".

13:6.note: "I fed them and they filled their bellies".

13:14.note: "Where is your victory, O death" (reads דבר as victory?).

13:15.note: "House of brothers"; פרא read as "separate"; clauses transposed.

14:3.note: Plus "your God", "for you"; כל not rendered; פרים read as "fruit".

14:4.note: Plus "and say"; "Assyrians"; "for you are merciful to the orphan".

14:5.note: "Their vows" for נדבה; כי not rendered.

14:9.note: Plus "and he will say"; עניתי read as "humbled"; ואשורנו as "praise".
